nodes.change_log:
Find the action faster!

New badges and a quick one-time guide help you discover Blight survival mode — punch back the husks with your bare hands and defend your glowing garden.

- "NEW" badges highlight every mode and option, including Blight survival
- A friendly "Try Blight mode?" guide invites you in your first time
- Clearer, easier-to-read menu labels
- Smoother first launch (menu fixes)
v1.0.0 (code 4) — Blight empty-level fix (orb-cap leak), live menu level readout, shorter inter-level break, plus the device-bug batch. Device-verified. Alpha test build.

What's New:                                                                                                                      
  - Interactive gesture tutorial — New players learn every interaction hands-on with a single orb: grab, stretch, poke, nurture,   
  punch, force pull, clap harvest, and open the menu. No more guessing.                                                            
  - Proximity glow — Orbs light up when your hand gets close, so you always know when you're in range.                             
  - Force Pull improved — Now works on orbs above and below eye level. Wider targeting cone for easier aiming.                     
  - Lush floor grass — Denser, narrower grass blades in a natural circular shape. Floating spores now glow as soft circles instead 
  of squares.                                                                                                                      
  - First-time action tips — Helpful hints appear the first time you try each gesture: planting, stretching, force pulling,        
  nurturing, and more.                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                   
  Fixes:                                                                                                                         
  - Force Pull no longer fails on high orbs                                                                                        
  - Grass no longer has visible square edges                                                                                     
  - Tutorial runs automatically for first-time users; returning players skip straight to their garden

NEW in v0.2.0:

Force Pull — hold your palm toward a distant orb and pinch to pull it to your hand, like a Jedi
Two-Hand Stretch — grab an orb, then pinch with your other hand and pull apart to stretch it like elastic. Release to watch it snap back!
Each orb type now grows to its own unique maximum size
Faster cup nurture — channel energy into orbs in just 1 second
Contextual tips guide you through new gestures the first time you try them
